source_operation: sewing a two-point self-energy packet to any labelled external leg multiplies the three-point normal jet by an analytic site-local factor
rank7_consequence: Projection of the dressed jet onto the original eleven labelled coordinates is triangular and invertible wherever F(0) is nonzero. Composing that projection with the established rank-seven source quotient preserves faithfulness.
coefficient_enlargement: A generic dressing can also create monomials outside the CM-generated tower, such as pure cubic normal jets. These are additional coefficient/readout coordinates, not new Carrier incidences and not needed to recover R7.
failure_support: F(0)=0, which is not perturbatively reachable from F(0)=1
